h1: Private Practice Physician Scheduling, Built For You
paragraph: Stop spending hours on private practice physician scheduling. Submit your rules and preferences, and Scheduling Wizard delivers a complete schedule built to your rules.

cta.title: Get Your Physician Schedule Done Right
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: A managed scheduling service means your practice submits its rules and requirements, and an expert team handles the schedule building on your behalf. Scheduling Wizard takes your physician availability, coverage requirements, and preferences, has a team that does this full time build it, and delivers a finished physician schedule as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you. Your practice gets a finished schedule without needing to learn or operate any scheduling software.
faq.question: What is a managed scheduling service for private practice physicians?

faq.answer: Physician availability, time-off requests, and personal rules are built in as first-class inputs. When you submit your rules, you can include individual physician preferences alongside your coverage requirements. Our team balances these preferences against practice needs, producing a schedule that reflects real-world rules rather than an idealized but unworkable template.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle physician preferences in private practice?

faq.answer: Fairness is built into the schedule. Weekends, holidays, and on-call shifts are distributed equitably across your physician group based on the rules you provide. Rather than relying on a human scheduler to manually balance burdens, our team balances the distribution every time a schedule is built.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard ensure fair scheduling across physician partners?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard delivers finished schedules as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you, ready for your practice to use immediately. If your practice uses a viewing or publishing platform, the finished schedule goes straight in. There is no separate platform or dashboard, the deliverable is a complete, finished schedule file your team can act on right away.
faq.question: What does the scheduling output look like for a private practice?

faq.answer: Private practice physician scheduling focuses on full coverage, physician partner fairness, and practice-specific rules rather than training requirements or regulatory frameworks like ACGME. We apply the same approach to fairness used in residency programs to private practice contexts, adapting to the specific rules and preferences your physician group provides.
faq.question: How does private practice physician scheduling differ from residency scheduling?

faq.answer: In most private practices, scheduling falls to a practice administrator, office manager, or managing physician partner. These individuals often build and maintain schedules manually in spreadsheets, absorbing significant time each month. Scheduling Wizard is designed for exactly this audience, removing the scheduling burden from administrators and partners so they can focus on patient care and practice operations.
